Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer repeatedly stayed on DuckDuckGo results and did not open authoritative pages (e.g., Wikipedia, museum entries) to extract the death year. This ignored the Planner’s instruction to “open credible pages” and “extract and report the death year,” causing the process to stall and preventing retrieval of the correct death year (1583) for Lorenzo Costa the Younger.
